SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   C. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   C. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   B. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   D. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.

9. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

10. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fieldwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa 5 5.2 The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Righ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Rights 5 5.4 African Diasporas 5 5.5 Citiz and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
